output.title: Detached 4-Bedroom Villa with Garden, Terrace, and Double Garage
output.description:
This detached villa offers approximately 200 square meters of living space distributed over a well-maintained layout dating back to the 1970s. The exterior showcases a stone facade characteristic of residential architecture from that period, offering both solidity and charm, complemented by private grounds including a front lawn and a mature garden.

Inside, the living room retains original features such as a stone fireplace and wood paneling, providing a warm and inviting atmosphere with views onto the garden. The layout comprises four bedrooms and two bathrooms, suitable for various lifestyle arrangements.

Outdoor living is enhanced by a terrace adjoining the property, overlooking a peaceful garden with mature trees, a large lawn, and a patio area. Additional amenities include a double garage providing secure parking and a cellar for storage. The villa's setting reflects an established residential area with mature landscaping and private spaces.

highlights.text: 200 m² detached villa with stone facade
Original stone fireplace in living room
Mature private garden with lawn and patio
